# `dirt`

Bare earth for floors and ceilings: blotches of soil, clods and pebbles.

![dirt](../images/dirt.png)

Category: [grounds](../catalog.md#grounds).

Own size: 64 × 64 pixels. Parameters marked **layout** are expressed at this size and scale with the patch; **detail** parameters are real pixels and never scale. See [Layout and detail](../concepts.md#layout-and-detail).

## Parameters

### General

| Parameter  | Type                            | Default                                        | Scale  | Description                                           |
| ---------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `size`     | [width, height] of integers > 0 | `[64, 64]`                                     | —      | own size of the patch, in pixels                      |
| `palette`  | array of CSS colors, at least 2 | `["#2e2217", "#4a3726", "#654b33", "#80623f"]` | —      | colors of the earth, from darkest to lightest         |
| `blotches` | number > 0                      | `4`                                            | layout | large blotches across the patch                       |
| `contrast` | number in [0, 1]                | `0.6`                                          | —      | spread of the blotches over the palette               |
| `clods`    | number ≥ 0                      | `8`                                            | —      | lighter lumps of earth per 32 × 32 pixels             |
| `pebbles`  | number ≥ 0                      | `3`                                            | —      | pebbles per 32 × 32 pixels                            |
| `grain`    | number in [0, 1]                | `0.14`                                         | detail | random brightness variation between pixels, in [0, 1] |
| `wetness`  | number in [0, 1]                | `0`                                            | —      | damp earth, darker, in [0, 1]                         |

## Usage

`dirt` is a ground, for floors and ceilings: bare earth seen from above, in large
`blotches` of darker and lighter soil, with fine crumbs, lighter `clods` and grey
`pebbles` lit from the top-left. `wetness` darkens it into damp earth. The same earth
shows through the bare patches of [`grass`](grass.md) and between the stones of
[`gravel`](gravel.md), set by their `dirt` group.

```json
{ "template": "dirt", "pebbles": 6, "wetness": 0.3 }
```

## Example

```json
{
  "$schema": "../../schemas/patch.schema.json",
  "template": "dirt",
  "size": [64, 64]
}
```
